about_the_game:
One man's trash is another man's treasure. A ShapeYard is where discarded shapes find new purpose. As a newcomer to recycling, your mission is to earn every recycling badge and prove yourself as a masterclass recycler.

Every run begins with selecting one of 12 unique characters, each with their own skills and special modifiers. They play a crucial role in forming your strategy.

With over 50 machines at your disposal, you can process, store, refine, and even destroy shapes. Choosing the right setup is mission-critical to maintaining a steady flow of shapes in and out.

The modifiers are the hidden champions of each run. With 100+ to choose from, finding the right combinations and mastering their synergies is the key to reaching the final recycling badged.

Each turn, the shop offers a selection of machines, modifiers, shapes, and more. As the game progresses, the shop evolves, and earning recycling badges unlocks new items permanently. How you spend your tickets is up to you, but every purchase counts.

There are various types of customers, each leveling up when served. Identifying and catering to the most beneficial ones for your strategy is key to success.

short_description: ShapeYard is a roguelike puzzle-strategy game where you select a starting character, acquire machines and modifiers, and complete as many missions as you can. Craft the perfect build, earn every recycling badge, and become a master recycler.
